title: Week 8 of creating an explorable island with AI: night sky aurora, procedural clouds and a cloud editor
author: MogensenJ
selftext:
Hi all!

Last week I shared [week 7](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1whz4rx/week_7ish_of_creating_an_explorable_island_with_ai/). This week I gave the sky a full rework, and it went through a few detours along the way 😄

**What's new**

* **Night sky aurora:** based on the [Auroras shader on Shadertoy](https://www.shadertoy.com/view/XtGGRt) (credit to its author, nimitz), adapted for the night sky and lined up with the horizon and water.
* **Procedural mesh clouds:** a single cumulus deck that drifts with the wind, casts shadows on the island, and floats over the terrain instead of sticking to it.
* **Cloud editor:** cloud settings live in the map editor now, so I can tweak the look per map. It has controls for how the clouds boil, grow and fade.

**How it went**

The clouds took a few tries. I built a standalone cloud designer, then layered weather, then raymarched volumetric clouds (man that's hard), deleted most of it, and eventually landed on simple mesh clouds that look better and run faster. Turns out the boring solution won 😅

**What's next?**

Still not sure! I should start thinking about a game mechanism I guess. 

Feedback and input is greatly appreciated!

comments.author: yakiri2000
comments.body: The sky work looks really nice, but “I should start thinking about a game mechanism”: 😄 Classic dev priorities.
